answer_1.quote: Keyphrases are short phrases that indicate the core information of a document... the keyphrase generation (KG) problem focuses on automatically producing a keyphrase set (a set of keyphrases) for the given document.

answer_2.quote: We engage F1@M which is recently proposed... as one of our evaluation metrics. F1@M compares all the predicted keyphrases... We also use F1@5 as another evaluation metric. ... Duplication ratio is denoted as "DupRatio" ...
